'''Quest''' was a board game played by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Chewbacca had a habit of throwing the board out of windows when he lost.<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>
